<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def block_state(tag):
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    # block rows 34-43, cols 27-36
    rows=[]
    for r in range(34,44):
        row=a[r][27:37]
        rows.append(''.join(c if c in 'pW' else '.' for c in row))
    print(tag,'block(top->bottom):')
    for i,r in enumerate(rows): print(' ',34+i,r)
def piece(tag):
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if 70<n['pixels']<100 and n['color'] in ('p','W'):
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            print(tag,'piece',n['color'],'px',n['pixels'],'rows',min(rs),max(rs),'cols',min(cs),max(cs))
action(['SPACE'])  # reset top half to white
block_state('after reset SPACE')
piece('piece now')
action(['LEFT','LEFT'])  # 90 deg
piece('piece after 2xLEFT (90deg)')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
